_comment: Clockless complex-pole band window (2026-10-18): E_K,r <- z_r E_K,r + gamma_r k~, D_V,r = z_r E_V,r, S = sum_r Re(a_r v^T E_K,r + b_r D_V,r^T k~), E_V,r <- D_V,r + gamma_r v; W <- (1 - eta) W + eta S; read = q~ (sum_t v k~^T + W)^T (tonic Hebb at gain 1 kept). R = 4, initial periods 2, 6, 20, 64 blocks with |z| = e^{-1/p}; a, b small random complex (std 0.1 per component); eta learned per head from 0.125 and projected onto eta <= 0.125 after every step. Against B-EMA: no clock (c = 0, no n omegaT), alpha absorbed into a, b, R bands.
